title: Canonical constant-coefficient restriction preserves all adic transitions
statement: Let X,Y be schemes, g:Y→X, d an adic coefficient datum and M an AdicTower [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Put P_n=constantAdicFiniteProjection(g,d,n) [def-weil-pbc-constant-adic-finite-diagram-data]. Build the sequential diagram with objects Res(P_n)(g* M_n) and consecutive arrows obtained from the actual restricted M transitions followed by pbcDerivedRestrictComp. For every n≤m, its (m,n) map is Res(P_m) of adicTowerRestrictedTransition(d,g,M,m,n), followed by that same canonical restriction compositor. No boundedness, local constancy, supplied stalk complex, marking or cover is needed.

source.place: Tags 03DA and 06YY; canonical exact scalar restriction, applied to the semilinear cocycle of def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower

proof.text: Ordinary scalar restriction compositors are identity on sections, so they satisfy associativity. The pullback/scalar-restriction comparison is the mate of the identity-on-sections direct-image square. Mate pasting and exact derived localization therefore preserve scalar composition.

Apply these identities and naturality to M.cocycle, first after inverse image and then after scalar restriction through P_n. The resulting all-pairs arrows compose. At equal indices M.transition identifies their scalar restriction with the identity on derived evaluation. Exact restriction reflects isomorphisms by the homology comparison, hence the equal-index arrow is invertible; its idempotent cocycle then forces the identity.
Induct on n≤m. The base is the identity just proved; the successor case uses Functor.ofOpSequence and the composition equation.

lean.statement:
theorem constantAdicRestrictedTower_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : AdicTower X d) (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m) :
    (constantAdicRestrictedTower g d M).map (homOfLE h).op =
      (pbcDerivedRestrict (constantAdicFiniteProjection g d m)).map
          (adicTowerRestrictedTransition d g M m n h) ≫
        (pbcDerivedRestrictComp (constantAdicFiniteProjection g d m)
          ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map (pbcAdicQuotient X d m n h))
          (constantAdicFiniteProjection g d n)
          (constantAdicFiniteProjection_comp g d m n h)).hom.app
            ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj
              (M.level n))
